title: CarrierProofOfDelivery
description: A Carrier's Proof of delivery, as the Carrier sends it to the Norvia Partner API (Carrier Proof of delivery format, version 1). It differs from the Canonical Model on purpose: its own field names, flat location fields, a local delivery time without an offset, alpha-3 country codes, and its files base64-encoded inside the JSON. It never names the Carrier: API Management takes the Carrier from the token (ADR 0005).

bookingRef.description: The Carrier's own reference for its booking.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Norvia Carrier booking number, such as CB-0000042. Used only when the reference doesn't match.

documentId.description: The Carrier's own ID for the Proof of delivery, unique per Carrier.

receivedBy.description: The name of the person who signed.

deliveryTime.description: When the goods were delivered, local to the location, without an offset.
